title: Campaign checks that tell you what to do
changes: “Ask Meta to check” now tries the whole campaign on Meta and removes it again, so it catches problems the old check missed. Nothing is left behind and nothing spends.
When Meta can’t build a campaign yet, the proposal says what to do instead, such as boosting the post from the Instagram app.

title: Clearer when Meta says no
changes: When Meta refuses a campaign, the proposal now says in plain words what an owner needs to do, and shows the refusal once instead of twice.

title: Marketing you can act on
changes: Growth Review: each week's spend, sales, return on spend and cost per purchase, the best product and creative, and a Scale / Hold / Improve / Stop call for every campaign. It also arrives as a notification on Sunday morning.

Campaign Proposals: propose a campaign with its product, goal, audience, Instagram post, budget, reason and success measure. An owner approves it, it is built on Meta paused, and it spends only when an owner switches it on.
Meta Campaigns now shows purchase value, return on spend and cost per purchase, a daily check of whether website purchases are reaching Meta, Meta's time zone, and where the KD rate comes from.
Instagram Performance now shows Instagram's own figures: reach, profile visits, website taps, and each post's reach, saves, shares and views.
The KD rate for ad spend now updates every morning. An owner can still pin one in Settings.

title: Attendance follows the person, not the spelling
changes: Renaming someone in HR no longer detaches their past attendance: lateness is judged against their own shift, and they are counted once in Present today.

title: Hours no longer counted twice
changes: If a clock-in goes through twice, the portal no longer adds the same hours twice; a second clock-in while you are already clocked in is now refused.

title: First numbered release
changes: Requests: leave, corrections and schedule changes in one Inbox, with reminders.
Leave goes to the store manager first, then to the owners.
An attendance correction asks for the actual times, and approving it fixes the record.
HR can change someone's working days and hours from the Employees page.
Lateness is judged against each person's own hours, with grace set per shift.
Clock in at whichever workplace you are standing in. Clocking out works without location.
Sales by shop come from the tills. The Time Keeper register is split into Online and WhatsApp.
Meta ads: spend in dinars, and what each campaign bought for which brand.
CRM: each customer's visits and Lightspeed purchases on one page, shown only to those allowed.
Send WhatsApp from the CRM and the follow-up board, with English or Arabic templates.
Birthday and anniversary reminders go to the right salesperson.
Fixed: the app going white on iPhone Safari.
The version and build now show in the app. Tap them to see this list.
